title: Our Work | Animation Studio | THE LINE Studio
description: Check out our extensive portfolio of work. We bring our own brand of artistry and ideas to everything we do.

children: Our second partnership with Digital Extremes to create ‘Jade Shadows: Constellations’, a new animated short set within the universe of Warframe.

We worked incredibly hard to make it as period-accurate as possible and, like all our projects, it was hand-drawn by an incredible team of artists. We even used a variety of practical effects in the film, which was a lot of fun to do. We had a brilliant time making this film and learnt a huge amount while studying the masters of the 60s and 70s.
I'm A Celebrity... South Africa trailer! It’s a family show a lot of us grew up with, and we remember the iconic moments from these celebs’ original seasons.

Our goal was to take viewers on a journey through decades of meaningful moments celebrated with luxury chocolate. We wanted each decade to introduce a new ensemble of characters, authentic to their time period. But you may notice a returning cameo of narrator (and Gossip Girl icon) Leighton Meester!
We has teamed up with cult US brand Touchland to create its first animated commercial, launching the brand’s new body and hair mists.
Buzz Chickson & The Hype Heads Intro

Buzz Chickson, an insomniac addicted to late night hunts for hype streetwear grails, believes he’s uncovered evidence exposing a secret organisation manipulating London’s streetwear scene. An evil conclave known as the Un-Scene.
In the trailer, we follow Melinoë, a young witch and moon goddess alongside her Headmistress, Hecate.

When our hero’s notice the electric field disturbances, they teleport themselves to another dimension where their powers are unveiled to defeat a lovecraftian evil and restore harmony to their universe.
In celebration of Blizzard's Overwatch 2 x Cowboy Bebop collaboration, we paid homage to one of the studio's most iconic series by putting our spin on the legendary opening sequence of Cowboy Bebop.

This piece is more than just a celebration of new in-game content. It’s a cinematic journey into a 
richly imagined universe.
Imagine our faces when we were told the next project we'd get to work on would be a Overwatch 2 x Transformers collab!
The Line, in collaboration with BlinkInk, is proud to present the video for ’Humility’, the first track from The Now Now, the brand new studio album from Gorillaz.
Azuki Elementals are a collection of characters within the four domains of the Garden: Earth, Fire, Lightning and Water.
Inspired by the shiny new Marvel Snap game, we were tasked with creating a music video for ‘Hero’. A banging new track by Martin Garrix & JVKE.
“Dear Alice” is a love letter from a grandmother to a granddaughter and an optimistic vision of the future of farming.
Cinematic for Uncapped Games' first release, Battle Aces.
Delivery at Dawn; A young hopeful rushes to the docks in the early morning to welcome a mysterious ship with a precious cargo.
This project lands slap-bang in the centre of the venn diagram of things we love.

‘Yes Boss’ – We were asked by our friends over at Art Practice to collaborate on an ident for the spanking new Channel 4 rebranding. They wanted us to create an ident set in Britain's most essential establishments, the corner shop.
Our series of videos from our collaboration with Jamie Hewlett and the Gorillaz team for their new YouTube series, Song Machine.
The BAYC team came to us to produce a teaser for a secret project they’ve been cooking up.
With rigorous training, strategic thinking and team bonding, the trio will take on the monumental task of battling the champions.
This was a welcomed reunion for us, not only with the wonderful team at 4Creative but also with Ignasi!
The film follows the "Protoframes" doing battle against an army of Tecnocytes.
This was an extremely satisfying project for us, almost feeling akin to one of our own personal projects!
Amaro & Walden are two rowdy boy racer, hipster hybrids with that lads on tour attitude. Follow them burning around London town acting like they’re top dons in a music video.
MARVEL SNAP / Go wide or Go home is action-packed promotional film for the new desktop edition of MARVEL SNAP.
A family sci-fi adventure featuring Connie, a young British/Caribbean girl who uncovers a giant mech with mysterious powers under the mountains of St Lucia.
VCT X Grabbitz. The music video captures that millisecond moment where our three key agents battle with their own subconscious, triggered by a decisive moment during the heat of battle.
We celebrated the launch of YT Industries new trail bike IZZO by creating a film that honours the classic anime fight sequence.
"Chaiki's Journey Season II" is an epic micro-series featuring the new Integra Type S from Acura, following the heart-racing journey of Chiaki, a Kakkoī racecar driver.
We’re thrilled to have teamed up with 4Creative for the Great British Bake Off’s 2023 teaser trailer.
We're very excited to share our new super-action-packed film, "Hypervoltaic Chronicles".
The 2022 League of Legends World Championships is finally returning home to North America for the first time since 2016 and The Line helped mark the event with a spectacular animated launch film!
Featuring Acura Integra Type S HRC Prototype this project marks our third collaboration with Acura, adding even more depth to Chiaki’s Journey!
The uneasy stasis of a space-dwelling Monarchy is shaken by the arrival of a hypnotic, luminous dwarf planet. Caught between the authoritarian Duke and the impulsive Prince, all will come to light.
A set of short animated clips to celebrate the launch of Sanrio webshop.
A web game where you're playing Leonardo DiCaprio running down the red carpet, trying to get an Oscar.
Our second collaboration with Overwatch2 for a trailer introducing the game's 40th Hero character - Venture!

In early 2019, we were invited to collaborate with Riot Games on a music video for “True Damage,” a virtual, global hip-hop collective composed of characters recast from the League of Legends universe.

‘Rise with Wagmi’ is one chapter in WENEW’s online storytelling project - an anthology piece that brings together content from a wide array of platforms, to tell the story of Wagmi and his shop: 10KTF.

2020 is the 10th anniversary of League of Legends esports and we couldn’t be more excited to be a part of this historic moment. To mark the event we teamed up with Riot Games to create a dynamic music video that celebrates the rich history of esports with one eye firmly on its future.
Watch the Supervive team prepare themselves for battle in this uniquely styled hype-film for TheoryCraft’s debut game.
'10KTF: The Kaiju's Problem' marks our second collaboration with 10KTF, and the latest instalment in an epic and ever-expanding narrative that started with a shopkeeper and his cat.
We were mega-hyped when UK based indie games company, Chucklefish asked us to produce a cinematic for their much-anticipated strategy game, Wargroove.
We helped to bring Gucci's 2018 spring summer campaign to life with intricate animation based on Ignasi Monreal's surreal fantasy paintings.

It's the year of the Rat, and to celebrate we were asked by Kenzo to re-create the Chinese Zodiac story inspired by vintage animation and 70s kung-fu movies.⁠ Vintage animation mixed with kung-fu movies, urr, yes please!

The Line brought to life the drawings of Swedish Illustrator Åsa Ekström in this explosion of flowers and springtime joy for Estée Lauder’s new product line containing ferment from the legendary Sakura tree.
We joined Starknet in creating a film celebrating the launch of STRK.
The Line explores cool non-photo-real styles in 3D
Produced and Created with Blizzard Entertainment.
Characters on the fringes of a really shit night out
The legend continues. A 2D animated commercial that tells the story of Mercedes Benz Maybach’s history, through a sequence of extraordinary living paintings by Ignasi Monreal.
Get a cup of your favourite beverage, clear your second screen and put this on for a relaxing, flow-state-inducing walk through the woods.
Nickelodeon contacted us to contribute to their Vine project to celebrate Nickelodeons 25th year of making amazing programming.

We gave Grace Neutral the full Sailor Moon treatment in this animated intro for Viceland' celebration of Anime. We were lucky to work with the talented Jeff Lai for the design and animation, and he absolutely crushed it.
Buzz Chickson outchea hustlin’ for Christmas.
We were asked by TBS to come up with some risky Idents for the their rebranding. Here's what we were allowed to get away with.
We’re really excited to bring you our third instalment of ‘Sessions’ for Riot Games Music.
We had the pleasure of contributing to the new Virgin Media Advert '9.58 Seconds' featuring legendary Usain Bolt. Directed by Seb Edwards.
We went back to an earlier era of animation in 'Santa's Workshop 2016', a christmas advert we created for Vipps, a mobile payment system for Den Norske Bank.

81Agency approached us to do a series of animations for Birchall Tea Instagram. We worked together with Benjamin Flouw to illustrate and animate a few beautiful moments of people enjoying their cup of tea.
We teamed up with Anomaly London, and illustrator, Rune Fisker to create a series of animated videos promoting Unilever’s various social welfare and education initiatives globally.
A short and spooky 2D animated looping film.
Here's two adverts we Directed for Campaign Magazine, they were to be shown on billboards around Cannes during the Cannes Lions Festival. They were banned on day one.
We teamed up with Discord for a special drop in honouring the Lunar New Year and in creating the cutest chibli inspired profile icons.
Animated advert for HSBC featuring extreme 2D sakuga effects
This is one of our first music videos and one of the first commercial projects under The Line banner.
Our 3D animated commercial for British broadcast platform, Freeview.
We were approached by Garena to tell the story of 4 young heroes

A game of football turns deadly as an uninvited player joins in.
7 episodes featuring this over-enthusiastic basketball with the small-man syndrome.
Super Turbo Atomic Ninja Rabbit is an intro sequence for the greatest TV series that never was. Created and Directed by Wesley Louis.
A story of a small delivery drone carrying a package across a vast ravaged landscape.
A calming video set to a relaxing soundtrack.
